def: The IEEE standard for floating-point arithmetic, defining binary and decimal formats, rounding, special values such as infinity and NaN, and exception handling; first published in 1985.
practice: FP64, FP32 and FP16 are IEEE binary formats, while BF16, TF32 and the FP8 and FP4 formats used in AI come from vendors and the Open Compute Project; the current revision is IEEE 754-2019, as of November 2026.
